name: motion-elastic-scale
title: Elastic Scale
description: Vòng tròn phóng lên 120 % rồi nảy qua lại 92 % và 106 % trước khi đứng yên.

moworks.author: moworks

options.keys: [[s, scale], ...]: power2.out to the first peak, sine.inOut between the rest
options.exitAt: s after the start to shrink to 0.5 and fade (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Circle scales about its centre by keys: 0.1 → 1.2 at 405 ms (power2.out) → 0.92 at 612 → 1.06 at 756 → 1 at 900 ms (sine.inOut between keys): an elastic.out look with shrinking rebounds. The curve graph is a guide. Exit: shrink to 0.5 + fade, 250 ms power2.in. Params: duration (0.9 s) · from (0.1) · keys: các đỉnh nảy (1.2 / 0.92 / 1.06).
moworks.titleVi: Phóng to đàn hồi, nảy nhỏ dần
